cache_contract.reused_data: SHA256 and stable signature of regular historical snapshot files only; never validation results, reference JSON, source inventories, evidence receipts, or semantic history decisions
cache_contract.first_read: Use existing stable streaming hash_file with no-follow descriptor/open and before/after metadata verification; retain pre-read signature and verify again after reading.
cache_contract.every_reuse: Repeat logical path no-link checks, exact snapshot_root/logical membership and physical snapshot path no-link checks, fresh regular-file signature checks, and caller-specific expected hash comparison. Checker snapshot reads reuse only paths already registered by validate_files.
cache_contract.final_audit: Fresh regular-file/no-linked-parent signature audit of the complete union at every Checker/progress boundary and outer read-only phase exit, including exceptions, semantic cache hits and child-only files. Tiny nested helpers retain fresh per-use stats and defer full-union audit to their enclosing boundary.

lifetime.owner: Dedicated SnapshotFileHashes object, separate from _history_cache and _history_stack. Checker.file_hash keeps its existing ordinary-file cache; only registered snapshot paths delegate to this owner.
lifetime.root_checker_run: Enter a fresh history snapshot hash scope unless called inside an already active invocation. Leave scope and audit in finally. A later run on the same Checker creates a fresh owner and performs new physical reads. Historical checkers retain copied original context/completion snapshot records and revalidate all files at every run entry, so an inactive owner never leaves an unused historical file unaudited.
lifetime.history_entrypoints: Standalone validate_context, validate_completion, validate_attempt, validate_transition, historical_checker, HistoryView.resolve, validate_files own fresh read-only scopes; nested callers share their active dedicated owner via ContextVar. Writing capture/assess/stage/activate/adopt helpers and CLI dispatch have no spanning owner; each validation before/after a known write phase gets a new owner. capture_continuation explicitly shares one read-only preflight scope across its initial attempt and every prior-attempt check; this closes before capture_context is called. This preserves linear semantic reuse without crossing a hard-link write boundary.
lifetime.progress: workflow_progress opens/reuses a bounded scope; each probe explicitly receives its active owner. Both standalone progress and checker-triggered ready projections audit the full shared snapshot union.
lifetime.module_aliases: Explicit owner transfer into historical/progress child checkers preserves the same bounded lifetime even when history and checker are imported through separate importlib aliases.
lifetime.inactive_owner: Owners are active only while scopes are entered. Retained checker attributes cannot revive an ended owner. Outermost exit clears cached hashes after auditing.

semantic_invariants: Preserve _history_cache reset and _history_stack cycle behavior exactly.
No expected-hash memoization: two references to the same bytes with different expected hashes are separately checked.
No archive, manifest, failed result, authority, or receipt changes.
Mutation, replacement, linked path, missing file, bad membership, or changed metadata blocks the affected result.
targeted_verification: single streaming physical read across root, historical child and ready projection
different expected hash rejected despite cached bytes
mutation during first read, between uses, child exit and outer exit rejected
fresh second run, standalone history call and CLI never trust an earlier owner
symlink, same-size replacement, missing file, membership changes and error-path final audit fail closed
limits: Synthetic local fixtures only. No old archive payloads, product, private ledger, provider, browser, network, Git, installation, or product QA claims.

initial_design_refinement.counterexample: A writing capture phase adds hard links to an already hashed blob inode, legitimately changing the ctime of existing snapshot paths. The initial whole-writing-command scope therefore rejected three actual capture fixture paths in the first targeted run.
initial_design_refinement.review_decision: Root confirmed strict identity/mtime/ctime checks stay unchanged. End and audit each read-only validation phase before writes; after writes require a fresh owner and full physical hash.
initial_design_refinement.no_longer_implemented: No owner spans history CLI dispatch or capture/assess/stage/activate/adopt writing helpers. No full-union scan at every tiny nested helper exit; outer phases and Checker/progress boundaries do audit the union.
initial_design_refinement.existing_regression: The first phase split made each prior-ref loop iteration a fresh phase, producing [18,39,63,90] checker calls and failing the unchanged linear-growth regression. A single bounded preflight scope around the whole read-only loop restores the intended operation cache; the unchanged regression passes.

semantic_cache_eligibility.registry_location: dedicated active hash owner; cleared at outer exit
guards: strong reference to actual caller semantic cache object
strong reference and identity equality for current cached result object
SHA256 of canonical JSON result content; recompute on every eligibility hit
semantic_cache_eligibility.fresh_owner: empty eligibility registry forces full dependency revalidation even when caller retains semantic results or historical checker _history_stack
semantic_cache_eligibility.unchanged: Existing semantic cache contents, stack/cycle checks, and normal top-level reset condition remain intact. No semantic cache is shared with progress children.
